# Career Pilot

Career Pilot is a practical, evidence-led AI job-search system for non-technical professionals, active job seekers, and career changers.

## Primary pages

- [Career Pilot AI Job Search Bundle](https://careerpilot.store/): Product overview for the 67-page Blueprint, 50 guided prompts, résumé template, and job-search checklist.
- [About Career Pilot](https://careerpilot.store/about): The principles and purpose behind the system.
- [Free AI Job Search Prompts](https://careerpilot.store/free-ai-job-search-prompts): Ten free prompts covering career direction, résumé improvement, applications, interviews, and planning.
- [AI Job Search Guides](https://careerpilot.store/blog): The Career Pilot educational resource hub.

## Guides

- [How to Use AI in Your Job Search](https://careerpilot.store/blog/how-to-use-ai-for-job-search)
- [AI Résumé Prompts](https://careerpilot.store/blog/ai-resume-prompts)
- [How to Tailor Your Résumé to a Job Description](https://careerpilot.store/blog/tailor-resume-to-job-description)
- [A Practical 7-Day AI Job Search Plan](https://careerpilot.store/blog/7-day-job-search-plan)

## Core editorial principle

AI should help people uncover, structure, and communicate their real experience. It should never invent qualifications, achievements, responsibilities, experience, or metrics.
